`UnifiedActivationPipeline` in `.aios-core/development/scripts/unified-activation-pipeline.js` activates all 12 agents; `generate-greeting.js` delegates. Phases: five parallel loaders, agent definition, sequential preference/session/workflow, enriched context, `GreetingBuilder`. `loadUserProfile()` passes into `_buildContextualGreeting()`; `GreetingPreferenceManager.getPreference(userProfile)` restricts bob mode except PM. Non-PM bob auto redirects; forced named shows simple greeting; commands empty. Eight agents have visibility arrays; qa, data-engineer, devops, ux-design-expert fall back to first 12; aios-master uses `visibility: full`.

When mocking `resolveConfig`, use `mockReturnValue` (not `mockReturnValueOnce`) if the function is called multiple times. Always mock `fs`, `js-yaml`, `config-resolver`, and dependency modules BEFORE requiring the module under test. `validateUserProfile()` is pure. `resolveConfig()` merges L1–L5, L5 highest; `user_profile` is USER_FIELD; `toggleUserProfile()` flips bob/advanced.

`PermissionMode`/`OperationGuard` live in `.aios-core/core/permissions/`; `index.js` wires `cycleMode()`/`enforcePermission()`. Cycle explore→ask→auto; `*yolo` is universal. Badge: `_safeGetPermissionBadge()`. Always match existing format when editing. Source: `.aios-core/development/agents/` -- Claude mirror: `.claude/commands/AIOS/agents/`; `ideSync` syncs separately.

Use `fs.writeFile(path, data, { flag: 'wx' })` for exclusive create lock - simpler and more testable than `fs.open('wx')`. Include PID + timestamp in lock data for stale detection. Stale ~10s; timeout ~3s; poll 50ms. Temp file (`{path}.tmp.{pid}`) + `fs.rename()` pattern. Windows: `rename` fails if target exists -- fall back to direct `fs.writeFile()`. Fingerprint `.git/HEAD` + `.git/index` mtimes; use `git rev-parse --git-dir` and `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`. Mock `child_process.execSync` separately from `execa`; use `jest.requireActual('fs')` for hook existence.

All section builders accept optional `sectionContext`; `_buildContextualGreeting` passes it. Context gives existing/workflow sessions brief named greetings; absent context preserves archetypal. `_safeBuildSection(fn)` uses SECTION_TIMEOUT (150ms) and try/catch. `Promise.all([contextSection, workflowSection])` parallelizes sections. ACT-5 changes (lines 661-816 in greeting-builder.js) must NOT be touched -- they own workflow navigator section.

`VerificationGate`: `.aios-core/core/ids/verification-gate.js`; `CircuitBreaker`: `.aios-core/core/ids/circuit-breaker.js`. Gates G1–G4: `.aios-core/core/ids/gates/g{n}-*.js`; use `IncrementalDecisionEngine.analyze()` (PUBLIC API only). G3 override needs `Boolean()`. All gates degrade gracefully. Jest `--testPathPattern` flag renamed to `--testPathPatterns` in newer Jest versions.

`RegistryHealer`: `.aios-core/core/ids/registry-healer.js`. Reuses `computeChecksum` and `extractKeywords` from `populate-entity-registry.js` (DO NOT duplicate). Registry nesting requires `buildEntityIndex()`. Backups: `.aios-core/data/registry-backups/healing/`; audit: `.aios-core/data/registry-healing-log.jsonl`. DO NOT mock `populate-entity-registry.js` in tests - functions work on any filesystem path; just use `os.tmpdir()` temp dirs. `jest.mock()` path hoisting: cannot use `path.resolve()` in mock path argument because `jest.mock()` is hoisted before `const path = require('path')`.

Use `os.tmpdir()` with unique suffixes for temp dirs in tests; cleanup with `fs.rmSync`. Verify only changed files lint clean. `jest.clearAllMocks()` does NOT reset `mockImplementation()` -- only clears call history. If tests override `mockImplementation`, subsequent tests inherit the override. Fix: explicitly restore default mock implementations in `beforeEach`, or use `jest.restoreAllMocks()` (which only works with `jest.spyOn`). For `jest.mock()` factories, must manually re-apply defaults.
